hypothesis: An additive observer accounts for every archived segment while exposing identity mergers, unsupported mappings and unavailable stress or lineage; generated quality is not expected to change.
layer: Final word.syllables surface observations. Prepared-base traces are counted for availability only and are not interpreted as complete lexical provenance.
cohort: Development only; retain the frozen validation cohort for later behavior-changing hypotheses.
accounting: segments = resolved + ambiguous + unknown; coarse tokens + aligned nulls = segments; source identities are never merged.
stress: Primary, secondary and unmarked are distinct observations. An absent marker is not silently converted to CMU stress zero. Counts are per nucleus segment, not per syllable.
collisions: coarsePreimages stores raw emitted sounds for each projected token; distributions can reveal actual many-to-one mergers. Potential loss flags also cover mappings whose alternate preimage is absent from a sample.
lineage: Recorded reduction is counted separately from unknown underlying identity; no recovered lexical identity is inferred from a reduced flag.
strata: Each profile and seed, plus actual morphology template x final syllable count. Raw symbols and observed stress remain separate dimensions.
acceptance: Complete accounting, aligned missingness, exact parity with the legacy mapping where defined, immutable input archives, repeatable observer reports and output/RNG parity in public-API fixtures. Coverage is diagnostic, not a wordlikeness score. No acceptance gate is tuned on these counts.
